classes.name: ScheduledInterviewSummary
classes.description: Represents a summary of scheduled interviews for candidates, providing counts of actionable interviews based on accessible candidate IDs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with a list of accessible candidate IDs.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the fixed group ID (5) associated with this action summary.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group name 'Candidates To Interview'.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of actionable scheduled interviews for the accessible candidates using the service layer.
